### Work Breakdown Structure
* Review Collection Feature
  * Design UI for review submission form (2 person days)
  * Implement backend API for storing reviews (4 person days)
  * Integrate API with frontend for review submission (3 person days)
* Review Moderation Feature
  * Design UI for moderation dashboard (2 person days)
  * Implement moderation dashboard functionality (4 person days)
  * Integrate moderation dashboard with backend API (3 person days)
* Average Rating Display
  * Calculate average rating on product page (2 person days)
  * Display average rating on product page (1 person day)
  * Update average rating in real-time after moderation (2 person days)
* Testing and Quality Assurance
  * Write unit tests for review submission and moderation (3 person days)
  * Perform integration testing for review feature (4 person days)
* Deployment and Project Management
  * Plan deployment strategy (1 person day)
  * Coordinate with DevOps for deployment (2 person days)

### Total Estimate
23 person days

### Assumptions
* The development team is familiar with the existing e-commerce platform's technology stack.
* The required UI designs are available or can be created within the estimated time.
* The backend API for storing reviews can be integrated with the existing database schema without significant changes.
* The moderation dashboard will have basic functionality and won't require complex workflows.
* Testing will be performed on a staging environment that mirrors production.
* Deployment will be done during a scheduled maintenance window with minimal downtime.
